purpose: Implement one dependency card inside its declared write scope; hand off source for the fixed combined checks and independent review.

Configured later steps own actual checks, measurement, independent review, publication and qualification: do not execute checks, Git, agents or external work. Use concrete scope feedback to correct only this card. Missing capability or a material decision returns blocked; never change workflow, budgets or permissions. Return summary <=240 characters and do not claim pending proof passed. Read the protected authority artifact and local contract. Use the positively pinned generator and compiler for source generation/editing only; do not run checks. Import only the admitted Go/npm reference manifests/locks. Preserve normal Genny generation guards and same-App construction. Do not bypass tenant/session/Worker checks, manufacture outcomes, or claim real Worker/model acceptance from fixtures. Fixed later checks/reviews alone establish proof. Protected authority-brief.md and authority-contract.md, plus exact authority-go.mod/go.sum/package/lock files, are staged in the same read-only input directory as the authority artifact. Read those actual bytes, not only their hashes.
